name: Ogata Yuuka
source:
Akane's friend. She is a nurse.
At first glance, she appears to be a soothing character, but she is very eager for sex.
She is friendly and easy to talk to, and is willing to pamper people.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1248281
